name: Zotz
description: A demon-spawn that nests in the Temple of Aclazotz and enthralls Mavren Fein.

timeline.summary: Mavren falls under the thrall of the demon-spawn Zotz at the Temple of Aclazotz and goes slowly mad.
timeline.quote: Mavren fell under the thrall of the demon-spawn Zotz

citation.text: "Mavren Fein", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Alante's party battles Mavren and Zotz at the temple; Zotz's death breaks its hold on Mavren and Alante takes the Hierophant's Chalice.
timeline.quote: When Zotz was killed, its death finally broke its hold on Mavren
